_meta.purpose: Per-reference HUMAN-REVIEW status for content/schema/references.ts. Phase 1 of the bib-human-review workflow (docs/workplans/2026-06-08-bib-human-review-workflow-design.md).
_meta.convention: Any references.ts id NOT listed under `reviews` defaults to 'unreviewed'. The bib-human-review audit flags every reference whose effective status is not 'validated'.
_meta.staleness: An entry is stale when its `entryHash` (12-char SHA-256 prefix of the canonical-JSON-serialized references.ts entry, recursively key-sorted) drifts from the current entry; re-review is required after drift. Computed by content/pipeline/validate-references-human-review.ts.

fields.by: GitHub handle of the human reviewer
fields.source: uploads/ filename, or 'issue#NNN' of the physical-review GitHub issue
fields.entryHash: 12-char SHA-256 prefix of the canonical-JSON-serialized references.ts entry (staleness gate)
